answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake deposit, like carving a canyon one grain at a time: slow to build, instant to lose. Each epoch, identities face random liveness challenges; missing one or signing contradictory statements slashes the stake. An attacker spawning a glacier of fake ids must fund each with real locked capital, and basalt-hard slashing rules burn it on detection, so sybil creation costs more than any reward it could capture.
